description: Measure how much JRuby time OpenVox Server used over a window, from the jruby.borrow-time its access log records for every request: JRuby-seconds in total and per time slot, catalog requests per node, and 503 responses. Needs read access to the access logs. Used internally by openvox_tune::capacity.

window_hours.description: How many hours back from now to read; defaults to 24

bucket_minutes.description: Length of the time slots for finding the busiest period, in minutes; defaults to 5

log_dir.description: Directory holding puppetserver-access.log and its rotated files; defaults to /var/log/puppetlabs/puppetserver
